I'm no expert on the sets feature, but I'll try to answer anyway.

Here's an example of a set.

Here's the concept, straight from the horse's goat's mouth:

Instead of frontpage being populated by content from default subs ordered by rank (thus having multiple submissions from a single sub while other, less active subs get less exposure), we should display the content in sets in a similar fashion of Google News - http://news.google.com/.

This feature should allow full user customization, allowing the user to add/remove subs from sets, add/remove sets or adjust the number of items in each set. Set page position should also be adjustable.
